notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market SaaS focused on customer insights and in-app support. Started with Hosted API trial to validate conversation flows and embeddings. Product/infra team prefers Redwood for transparent perf metrics and rollout controls. Key ask: move to Dedicated for stable Latency and predictable unit costs once pilot proves ROI.

Technical requirements / asks (from SE calls):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for typical chat path (<=128 tokens), p95 < 400ms for long responses (<=512 tokens).
- Throughput: baseline 30 RPS with burst to 120 RPS during morning peak. Autoscale + warm standby required.
- Models: prefer open models, looking to test Mistral/Falcon-L variants; want ability to pin versions and fallback to cheaper quantized variants.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high — target 30-40% improvement vs current hosted rate before committing Dedicated SKU.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latencies, trace hooks to link into Datadog.
- Data: user messages must be segregated; retention controls (30/90/365 day options) + data residency in us-east required.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, KMS BYOK preferred, SOC2 attestation needed, vulnerability scan & pentest report requested.

Procurement/legal state: Legal returned MSA with multiple redlines — key points: liability cap increased request, broader indemnity language, breach notification timeline tightened on their side. DPA redlines request strong residency guarantees and restrictions on subprocessors; want explicit list. Procurement asks for SLA credits > 99.9% uptime and clear latency SLOs tied to credits.

Commercial: Pricing discussion ongoing — AE presented Dedicated pilot SKU (3 months) with committed baseline + overage. Finance needs an itemized quote + SOW to push PO.

Customer quote from demo: "We need predictable performance + clear fallbacks — if you can guarantee latency and give us BYOK, procurement will push this through in Q1."

Next bits: circulate redline-enabled MSA + DPA, confirm subprocessors list, attach SOC2 report, produce Dedicated pilot cost breakdown and expected unit economics (tokens/sec) for their workload. Schedule 30m legal sync w/ Jordan + Priya + VL legal on week of 03/08.
